verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-LLM-ready-text and web search API. A data-extraction service of this kind could plausibly offer job monitoring, data-quality checks and failure alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents none of them: no performance dashboards, no data-quality validation, and no alerting or webhooks. Schema-guided extraction (x-json-schema) is an extraction feature, not data-quality validation, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor job performance, validate data quality, and receive alerts when something fails
